verdict.rationale: No first-party doc describes a native bulk or batch primitive. The only relevant evidence is a community report of a custom crew that categorized, labeled and deleted many emails, which shows bulk work is possible by building your own agents and tools rather than as a shipped feature. Crews and Flows can chain multiple tasks, but that is orchestration, not explicit many-item batch execution. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk execution API (e.g., running a crew over a list of inputs), bulk-operation controls (concurrency, partial-failure handling), first-party docs, and hands-on corroboration.
